metadata.question: Between December 2021 and January 2022, was the mean snow cover on Villarrica greater than the 2000 to 2020 average for the same months?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy – Collection: MODIS/Terra Snow Cover Daily L3 Global 500 m (MOD10A1) – band “NDSI_Snow_Cover” gives % snow cover per pixel. – Periods: • Target window: 1 Dec 2021 – 31 Jan 2022 • Climatology baseline: 1 Dec 2000 – 31 Jan 2020 (20 winters) – Location: Villarrica volcanic area, Chile (~39.4°S 71.9°W). A 5-km radius circle keeps the lake out and avoids huge pixel counts, yet captures the volcano cone. 2. Masking strategy – Use the built-in QA: keep pixels with “NDSI_Snow_Cover” ≤100 (0–100%). Flag value 211 (no decision) is masked out. – No cloud mask is needed because MOD10A1 already outputs a snow-cover % for every cloud-free observation; cloudy pixels simply do not appear (or carry the flag), so they naturally drop when we mask by the valid range. 3. Logic – Compute mean snow-cover % for each period. – If any collection is empty → C1. – After masking, if the valid-pixel count is zero → C2. – If the calculated mean is None/NaN → C3. – Otherwise compare 2021/22 mean vs 2000-2020 mean → A (Yes) or B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Area of interest (5 km radius around Villarrica volcano) villarrica = ee.Geometry.Point(-71.94, -39.42).buffer(5000) # 2. Retrieve both periods recent, c1 = get_mean_dec_jan(2021, 2022, "Dec21-Jan22") clim, c2 = get_mean_dec_jan(2000, 2020, "Clim 2000-2020") if recent is None or clim is None: if c1 == 0 or c2 == 0: print("C2") else: print("C1") else: if recent > clim: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Area of interest (5 km radius around Villarrica volcano)
villarrica = ee.Geometry.Point(-71.94, -39.42).buffer(5000)

# 2. Helper to get mean snow cover for a given Dec-Jan window
def get_mean_dec_jan(start_year, end_year, desc):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1')
             .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover')
             .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(start_year, end_year, 'year'))
             .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(12, 1, 'month'))
             .filterBounds(villarrica)
             .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.lte(100))))  # flag 211 etc. masked
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        print(f"{desc}: no images")
        return None, 0
    mean_img = col.mean()
    count = (mean_img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                                   geometry=villarrica, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)
                      .get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo())
    if count == 0:
        print(f"{desc}: no valid pixels")
        return None, 0
    mean_val = (mean_img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                                     geometry=villarrica, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)
                        .get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo())
    print(f"{desc}: Images={n}, Mean={mean_val:.2f}, Pixels={int(count)}")
    return mean_val, count

# 3. Retrieve both periods
recent, c1 = get_mean_dec_jan(2021, 2022, "Dec21-Jan22")
clim, c2 = get_mean_dec_jan(2000, 2020, "Clim 2000-2020")

if recent is None or clim is None:
    if c1 == 0 or c2 == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    if recent > clim:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
